text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 06 · 浅水中的遗迹花园.
Environment:  An original sunken garden within roofless pale limestone abbey ruins, broken arches and gentle ivy above a very shallow clear reflecting pool. A broad safe-looking stone walkway leads from foreground toward a single intact arch opening onto soft fern woods. Small patches of cream wildflowers and weathered steps, sky visibly bright through open roof. Photoreal tangible stone pores, airy reflected daylight and soft sage palette. Romantic discovery rather than ominous ruin, no statues or carvings of beings, water empty of fish.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 06 · 浅水中的遗迹花园. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
